It is not a rewritten Findings-land landing, not a stale currency label, and not a digest defect. It is an internal contradiction about which frozen G21 leftover-joins the subject says are unrecorded.

observations: 1. The four-file, no-Windows shape of the D-358 authoring verifies independently: fixtures/g21.v25/ contains exactly four files, one per occupancy v2 platform directory, all four sharing digest ad8cb54a1c4020b3a094ebfa02b0642383cf053976505f392501a45a82ec5f6e with the fixtures/g21.v24/ first-authoring, and a case-insensitive find for 'windows' under the whole fixture tree returns nothing. The sibling copy sets the subject also recites (g21.v16, g21.v21, g21.v23) are likewise four files each.

2. D-358's own COORD entry independently corroborates the subject's central standing claim: it states 'Frozen leftover-join.v39 of G21 remains the D-357 current recorded G21 leftover remasurement' and 'Frozen leftover-join.v14 of sarif remains the D-347 current recorded DR-122 leftover remasurement'. The subject does not overreach either.

3. The v40-to-v41 successor rename was performed as a token substitution that could plausibly have corrupted neighbouring tokens ending in zero. A reverse-substitution test across all 57 changed fields shows it did not: every non-substantive change is exactly the speaker token. g21-fixture-corpus.v30, doctor-actor leftover-join.v10, D-350 and D-330 are all intact.

4. findingDisposition.codexV40MustFix recites Codex's two v40 MUST-FIX as 'same class as G21LJ-V40-M1 G21LJ-V40-M2 G21LJ-V40-M3 and G21LJ-V40-M4 / findingDisposition.codexV29MustFix' with identifierInvented false. That is accurate: the live Codex v40 review carries two findings with identifier null, whose loci are the same five fields the Claude findings name, and it mints no id.

5. The remeasurementClause do-not-unwrite list now runs through D-358 and includes every recording D-number the subject relies on. Its currency sentence names v39/D-357, its occupancy sentence names occupancy v4, and its DR-114 sentence names doctor-actor leftover-join.v12 — all three verify.

6. Tested as the strongest available counter-evidence to the subject's claim that 'CC-5 prefix exactly at the operative bound' remains unauthored: docs/coop/artifacts/fixtures/g21.v9/G21.cc5.prefix-exactly-at-prehandshake.bin exists on disk (4 bytes, 00 01 00 00 = 65536) and is tracked in git under the D-301 commit. It does not disturb the standing. It is residue of the rejected g21-fixture-corpus.v9 candidate — g21-fixture-corpus.v10 records the rejection reason verbatim ('G21.cc5.prefix-exactly-at-prehandshake pinned RF-2 on N=65536, which the quoted preHandshake clause classifies as accepted') — and the injection was never recorded. Live COORD contains no occurrence of 'prefix-exactly'; g21-fixture-corpus.v11, the artifact D-301 actually recorded, authors only G21.cc5.prefix-far-over-prehandshake; and the subject cites no fixtures/g21.v9/ path in recordedInputs. The subject's recital is correct and it does not first-author the class.

7. Non-rejecting wording variance, recorded but not filed: the subject describes the D-356 invalid-UTF-8 injection as 'remasured stale' in authorityClaim and registerRowNote and as 'remains stale' in purpose, where the dispatch uses 'remains'. Both readings are defensible (the candidate does re-measure the whole set each cycle), the pairing is byte-inherited from leftover-join.v40 of G21 and older accepted ancestors, and neither form asserts anything false about the authoring standing. It is noted for the record only and is not part of the rejection.
